options: En svag 2 i en ukendt major (Multi)
bonus.why: Flannery 2♦ viser præcis 5-4 i majorerne med 11–15 hp. Med 16+ åbner man 1♥ og melder spar bagefter, så 1♥ benægter fire spar under 16 hp.

options: A weak two in an unknown major (Multi)
bonus.why: Flannery 2♦ shows exactly 5-4 in the majors with 11–15 HCP. With 16+ you open 1♥ and bid spades later, so 1♥ denies four spades below 16 HCP.

bonus.correct: Kun med lang ruder og svag hånd
options: Kun med lang ruder og svag hånd
bonus.why: 2♦ er ikke krav, men makker passer kun med ruderlængde. Med en svag hånd giver man præference til 2♥ eller 2♠, og 2NT spørger efter åbners fordeling.

bonus.correct: Only with long diamonds and a weak hand
options: Only with long diamonds and a weak hand
bonus.why: 2♦ is not forcing, but partner passes only with diamond length. With a weak hand you give preference to 2♥ or 2♠, and 2NT asks for opener's shape.

bonus.q: Hvad viser 3♥ som svar på 2NT efter Flannery?
options: Fire kort i en minor, minimum
bonus.why: 3♣/3♦ = fire kort i minoren og minimum · 3♥ = 5-4-2-2 med minimum · 3♠ = 5-4-2-2 med maksimum · 3NT = maksimum med hold i begge minorer · 4♣/4♦ = fire kort i minoren og maksimum.

bonus.q: What does 3♥ in response to 2NT after Flannery show?
bonus.correct: A minimum without a side suit – 5-4-2-2
options: A minimum without a side suit – 5-4-2-2
A maximum without a side suit
Four cards in a minor, a minimum
bonus.why: 3♣/3♦ = four cards in the minor and a minimum · 3♥ = 5-4-2-2 with a minimum · 3♠ = 5-4-2-2 with a maximum · 3NT = a maximum with stoppers in both minors · 4♣/4♦ = four cards in the minor and a maximum.
